name: Create an environment variable
description: Create an environment variable Create an environment variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/variables
Create an environment variable that you can reference in a GitHub Actions workflow. Authenticated users must have collaborator access to a repository to create, update, or read variables. OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; environment_name (path) — The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.; body (body)

name: Get an environment public key
description: Get an environment public key Get the public key for an environment, which you need to encrypt environment secrets. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/secrets/public-key
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{environment_name}/secrets/public-key
Get the public key for an environment, which you need to encrypt environment secrets. You need to encrypt a secret before you can create or update secrets. Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint. If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; environment_name (path) — The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.
